'Anyway. I was hoping we'd be able to help each other out. I know you said I shouldn't look into before I died, but maybe if I can regain memories of when I came into existence, it could help both of us - I'd get some closure and be able to move on, and you might get some data.'
she shakes her head "I have not fabricated a mind, nor soul yet.  They are no more human than a dog.  I keep them alive while they give me good information, then I recycle them"
'Just since I don't know what I might experience, I invited some friends to help keep me calm. I hope that's alright.'
'I might have been what you're looking for - but I don't know.'
"Hey, Heore, right? I think we've met once. We had some weird thing sticking out of the street the other day here in Hamp'. Lunged at us and snatched some pigeons. One of yours, maybe?"
she looks at Sabrine "I still think you should just accept who you are, but I could try apply a charge to your brain and maybe that would wake something up?"
"what did it look like?"
(ill try to move to replying since this convo is likely to have multiple threads)

'I agree, I should, but... for Kukudh's sake especially, I think I should look into finding out.' as she talks, Kukudh shyly looks over from Roy's shoulder, shaking back into visibility. 'They've been having slight... existential crises and feel it's preventing them doing their job effectively.'
"Big mouth sticking out of the street, several rows of teeth, some tentacles or such. I think like green liquid stuff inside, didn't get close enough to examine it, a bit busy at the time."
"Would you like to come downstairs and I try to shock the memories awake?" she says with a slight gleem in her eye

'See, they're a part of me like most familiars, but as a Guide they're also a lot more - we had the theory that they're lost childhood memories, but whether that's mine I forgot, or those of whoever had my body before me, or someone else...'
'...if my friends can come with me. Just for, well, all our safety. I'm not strong, but... living people can do a lot with this thing called 'adrenaline', I hear.'
"Green, not grey or blue?"
she makes 20 goodberries and puts them in a pouch, which she hands to Roy. 'In case. If I'm awake I can channel power and heal myself, too, but if not...'
"Of course they can come. I would be happy to let them watch as I operate on your brain"
"Out of these three, I think it was green the most. At least that's what was dripping from its mouth. Body itself kinda dark-ish. Wait, are you gonna have your brain poked at, Sab?"
she shivers slightly. 'I... was hoping there was some more, ah, psychic way...'
'I had a ***Thing*** in my head. I can take a bit of psychic probing. But I---what even am I? I know I'm a frog, but do I have a name besides that? I haven't seen anyone like me.'

It went away somewhere before we came back, so you might still be able to get it. At least it was satisfied with a pigeon, and not making more of a mess like the bacon thing."
"Mal?  Malathor?  Your friends of Malathor?!"
Ed nods at that and continues listening in
'Acquaintances, mostly. We're friends with his apprentice---ex-apprentice?---Bo, though.'
"Well, some of our friends are. Just met him like thrice so far."
`Yeah, Mr. Sandwich is an interesting guy.`
"Oh thats too bad.  You really should become his friends.  Hes such a good and honest guy.  Hell he is half owner of the bar here"
"So I suppose he wasn't pulling my leg when he said that pork giant thing was a creation of you both, then?"
'...Heore. Do you know why it went berserk? I... don't want that to happen to me.'
'I hope you understand, if I'm going to consider having someone poking around in my brain... I need to be sure.'

"Yes.  I find it hard to get parts, so he often supplies for me.  Though, he seems to care for the dears like they are people.  Such a kind heart on that guy.  He really should toughen up.  But regardless hes a good friend"
"At a guess, when I forgot to feed it, it broke out.  What the experiments lack in brains they make up with in brawn"
'...no wonder. I haven't been needing food for long, but hunger is an awful feeling...'

"Yeah to be honest, that thing was a bit freaky. It talked, called him its father, but the whole thing was also kinda weird when he seemed to care for it, but stayed behind when we went to pacify it. I'll be honest, it kinda pissed me off seeing how it acted like a child, and went mad, all while he stayed behind."
"no worry, seems to have been taken care of"
"Dont think of it as a child.  More of a dog, or maybe rat.  It doesnt know what it thinks really." she pauses and flips to one of the last pages "remove face to make it less human looking"

Roy shrugs. "Maybe it's just something here, back home we treat our animals like family too, but I suppose I see what you meant. He said that wasn't made of any human parts, so did it like have a brain of its own or something?"

(a rat, huh.)
'...it knew at least a little Common, though. It was able to communicate with us. And it was hurting.' she shivers again. 'It made me understand why people wanted me dead when I was a corpse. Out of pity.'

"Its common for people to project people's characteristics on animals and on objects, but its just animals.  If a dog bites you,you kill it.  If a person bites you, you jail it.  See, you dont treat animals as people, you know their place"
"these creations of mine are jsut animals that can talk.  You realyl shouldn't see them as anything else"
"anyway, step into my parlor" she says with a small pause "The pit and lets hook your brain up"

"Maybe it's just my upbringing, but still, animals can be understood. Sometimes if a dog bites you screwed up somewhere. Out of curiosity, ever considered seeing how these things develop on their own?"
they are, thats why I keep an eye on them.  The oldest one has been around for" she looks in the book "10 years"

she hesitates. '...I'd still like to look around a little first, if that's alright. Think for a bit on if I want to go through it... this would be a lot easier if I still had that telepathic connection...'
"what are you looking for.  You have been down there before"
'I want to magically clean things that'll be needed. It's not that I don't trust you to keep it clean, but I'd like to be completely sure.'
"OH you dont need to worry about that.  The black blood keeps out infection"
'...but I don't have that any more.'
"You will.  Its used to seal you up after I cut open your head and attach the electrodes"
'My blood is... um... I don't know what colour it is, but I think it's normally red? Might be blue. But it's definitely not black, I can't see it through my skin any more.'
'Will this have any negative effects on me? It likely wouldn't have been a problem before, but now...'
"As long as you dont die, It will just heal you up good as new"
'Can I also ask what exactly it is, out of curiosity? Is it... related to the strange fog around here? I remember something like that from when we brought Tortellini here...'

"Quite impressive, honestly. Oddly enough, that's reassuring. The whole thing still freaks me out a bit, but if you're keeping some that long and it's not causing any problems, then I hope I won't have to shoot down any more of them out in the streets."
she flips to a page in her journal and points "you can ask, but unless you read this, you'll never know.  Too many people want what I have devoted my life to figuring out"
"most I recycle within a year or so.  But some I keep on for long term study"

'...that's fair.' though she looks slightly concerned still. 
'Alright, incentive to keep me alive,' she jokes to break the tension, laughing soundlessly, 'if you're ever urgently in need of food for any of your creatures, I can make berries that should be able to sustain them long enough for you to find proper food. I'd rather use a bit of my energy than have them rampage.'
she nods "Oh I have a very *specific* diet for them" she leads to the trap door and starts heading down
"You sure know how to pick words so they sound most concerning to laymen." Roy turns to Sabrine. "You sure about that?"
"Is it sandwiches?"

'...if I can teach her anything with this, then she might work out how to make - and then promptly look after - a mind. You're right about it being reassuring, at least to me.' she silently laughs again. 'And besides, if this works, she'll owe me a favour. Maybe. Those medical skills could help so many people.'
